meta.name: Required Forms Workflow
meta.description: End-to-end test of the required form flow. Covers: creating a required_form template with an rf_built_in_section schema, publishing it, attaching it to a service, sending an invite, verifying the public /submit UI renders the violet שדות חובה section with the correct rf_ fields inside it (not in a generic section), filling the rf_ fields, submitting the form, and asserting the client_profile first_name / last_name / date_of_birth were updated in the backend.
meta.author: claude-ai

steps.description: Log in as admin

workflows.name: API – Create and publish a required-form template with rf_built_in_section
workflows.description: Creates a required-form template whose schema already contains the rf_built_in_section with rf_first_name, rf_last_name, and rf_date_of_birth questions, then publishes it.

steps.description: Create the required-form template. Pass the full schema inline so it contains rf_built_in_section from the start – no separate save_draft step needed.

sections.title: שדות חובה
sections.description: פרטים אלו ישמשו לעדכון פרופיל התלמיד/ה

steps.description: Publish the required form so the public invite endpoint can serve the canonical schema.

workflows.name: API – Create the required-forms test student
workflows.description: Creates a fresh RF test student for this run and resets their first_name, last_name, and date_of_birth to baseline values so the post-submission assertion can confirm the rf_ answers actually updated the profile.

steps.description: Create a run-specific RF test student.

Reset the client_profile to known baseline values so the post-submit assertion can prove the rf_ answers overwrote them. A clean baseline is required – the update might be a no-op if the values already match what the form will set.

workflows.name: API – Create a service with the required form attached
workflows.description: Creates a service whose required_forms config references the published RF template.

steps.description: Create a service and attach the required form template.

workflows.name: API – Send the required-form invite and verify the invite payload
workflows.description: Sends the invite and then loads it via the public endpoint to confirm the flow is 'required_form', and stores the invite token for the UI test.

steps.description: Send the required form invite for the test student.
Load the invite payload via the public API. If the flow or schema is wrong, we'll catch it in the UI step; here we confirm the endpoint returns 200 and store the flow for reference.

workflows.name: UI – Public /submit page: violet section, fill rf_ fields, and submit
workflows.description: Navigates to the public /#/submit?invite= page (no login required). Asserts: (1) violet שדות חובה section is rendered; (2) rf_first_name and rf_last_name inputs are rendered inside that section; (3) the generic שאלות נוספות wrapper is NOT present (rf_ items are not leaked into a plain white section); (4) the form can be filled and submitted successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to the public form submit page using the invite token. The SPA loads the form without requiring OTP.

Wait for the violet שדות חובה section header to appear. This confirms: (a) the invite was loaded successfully, (b) the rf_built_in_section is in the form schema, and (c) SectionedFormRenderer correctly styled it violet.
Assert the violet section header text is exactly 'שדות חובה'.
Assert the rf_first_name input is rendered. The id matches the item id in the schema, as set by SectionedFormRenderer.
Assert the rf_last_name input is rendered.
Assert the rf_date_of_birth date input is rendered.
Assert there is NO generic 'שאלות נוספות' section title visible. This is the critical regression check: rf_ items must NOT appear inside a plain white section.
Assert rf_first_name is NOT inside a white/slate border section (which would indicate it leaked out of the violet rf_built_in_section into a generic section).

steps.name: rf-public-form-before-fill
steps.description: Screenshot the form before filling – should show the violet שדות חובה section at the top.
Fill the rf_first_name field with the new first name that will be written to client_profiles.first_name.
Fill the rf_last_name field with the new last name.
Fill the date_of_birth field. The date input uses YYYY-MM-DD format.
Confirm the first name input actually has the value we typed (guards against silent fill failures).
Confirm the last name input actually has the value we typed.

steps.name: rf-public-form-filled
steps.description: Screenshot the filled form before submission.
Give the controlled form state a short turn to settle after typing before submitting.
Click the 'שלח טופס' submit button inside the required_form form element.
Wait for the submit API call to complete. This ensures the rf_ patch to client_profiles has been applied server-side before we navigate away to assert.
Wait for the CardTitle to show the success state ('הטופס נשלח בהצלחה'). This confirms the submit returned 200 and setStep('done') was called.
Assert the page title changed to the success message.

steps.name: rf-public-form-success
steps.description: Screenshot the success state.

workflows.name: API – Verify client_profile was updated by the rf_ answers
workflows.description: Calls GET /api/client-profiles/:id to confirm the submit handler patched client_profiles.first_name, last_name, and date_of_birth from the rf_ answers.

steps.description: Fetch the student's client profile. The call will fail (non-200) if the profile doesn't exist, which would also fail the test.

workflows.name: UI – Navigate to student page and assert updated name is shown
workflows.description: Navigates back to the admin UI and opens the student overview to confirm the updated first_name and last_name returned by the submission handler are reflected in the UI. This is the strongest possible end-to-end check: form fill → backend patch → admin UI display.

steps.description: Navigate to the student overview page. Auth is still active in localStorage from the initial login.
Wait for the student page to finish loading.
Assert the updated first name 'עדכון' appears somewhere on the student page. This proves the rf_first_name answer was written to client_profiles.first_name.
Assert the updated last name 'מבחן' appears somewhere on the student page. This proves the rf_last_name answer was written to client_profiles.last_name.

Assert the OLD baseline first name 'רקסט' is NOT visible on the page. This is the inverse check: confirms the old value was actually replaced, not just that the new name happened to coincidentally appear alongside the old one.
Navigate to the student forms tab to verify the required form submission is recorded.
Wait for the forms tab panel to render.
Assert the forms tab panel is visible (basic sanity that the tab loaded).

steps.name: rf-student-forms-tab-after-submit
steps.description: Screenshot the forms tab to capture the submission record.
